L1_speculative_decoding.what: Qwen3-0.6B (Q8_0) as draft model for Qwen3-8B in llama-server (--model-draft); greedy decoding, JSON-schema constrained
L1_speculative_decoding.ngram_variant: --spec-type ngram-simple (no draft model, no extra GPU memory; extraction copies spans of the answer). Added 2026-11-22 before any latency measurement
L1_speculative_decoding.quality_check: extraction outputs on the dev answers: share byte-identical to the baseline output; if not identical, claim-level F1 vs the baseline claims (NLI judge, as NB03) ≥ 0.98
L1_speculative_decoding.vram_check: peak GPU memory of the server ≤ 6.0 GB budget

L2_rerank_pool.quality_check: end-to-end macro-F1 on the dev split with the selected EXP-08-002 configuration: Δ ≥ −0.01 vs pool 50

L3_batched_retrieval.what: one BM25 / dense / cross-encoder call for all claims of an answer instead of one per claim
L3_batched_retrieval.quality_check: retrieved rankings identical (up to fp16 tie order) to per-claim retrieval

L4_warm_server.what: demo: keep the LLM server running between requests; the PyTorch models stay on the GPU if the total peak ≤ 6.0 GB, otherwise the unit embeddings are searched on the CPU

L5_second_opinion_tokens.quality_check: label agreement with the 300-token run on the routed dev pairs ≥ 0.98

decision_rules.adoption: a lever is adopted if its quality check passes AND it reduces the median latency of its stage by ≥ 10% on the dev set; the final per-answer latency (median, p95) is reported on the test answers / claims with all adopted levers
decision_rules.reporting: every latency figure is measured on this laptop and logged with the hardware record; no estimated figure is reported as measured
